original_test_intent: Verify the canonical SMBIOS Type 3 Thermal State metadata for the intended enclosure matches the approved normal-state enumeration and persists after reboot. The trailing phrase describes the chassis-status field group, not a second status or a live thermal stress test.
original_method: Archive full Type 3 records, bind the target enclosure by identity/BOM, parse raw and decoded Thermal State, compare with the approved metadata baseline, reboot and repeat without changing cooling, adding heat or applying stress.
manual_activity: A user approves the field mapping, expected enum and reboot plan. Metadata extraction and persistence comparison are automatable.
required_inputs: Approved source-hierarchy to Thermal State mapping
safety_requirements: Read SMBIOS only; do not modify cooling, apply load/heat, block airflow or inject a thermal fault under this case.
Preserve complete Type 3 output and raw enum; do not rely on the concatenated phrase grep.
Do not confuse static Type 3 Thermal State with live BMC sensors, warning thresholds or stress behavior.
Do not invent a generic second status; reject reserved/out-of-range enums and wrong-enclosure records.
Stop on ambiguity, drift or reboot failure; no automatic retry.
agent_execution_scope: Collect all Type 3 structures, select the enclosure, parse canonical Thermal State and compare raw/decoded values before/after reboot.
Do not alter thermal conditions, claim live sensor/stress coverage, modify DMI or decide PASS/FAIL.
engineer_actions: Approve field semantics, expected metadata enum and enclosure mapping.
Decide separate sensor/load/fault coverage and issue the verdict for this metadata case.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Not authoritative because the descriptive phrase is not the canonical decoded label; it also suppresses errors and discards record/enum context.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Preserve source wording, archive complete Type 3 output/tool/errors and parse record-scoped canonical `Thermal State` plus its raw enum.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The exact source hierarchy, Type 3 script and 5/5-minute values are retained.

modernized_recommendation.status: STATIC TYPE 3 THERMAL STATE ENUM CHECK
modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Map the hierarchy to one canonical Thermal State member, compare raw and decoded values for the mapped enclosure across reboot and explicitly exclude dynamic temperature, cooling and fault-response behavior.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record SMBIOS, dmidecode, BIOS, enclosure and BOM revisions.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable SMBIOS Type 3 System Enclosure or Chassis States enumeration and installed dmidecode documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Corrects extraction and prevents unsafe expansion into a thermal stimulus while retaining metadata coverage.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: No reduction to the source metadata check; live thermal behavior remains separate.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: A static firmware field does not establish real-time thermal health or protection behavior.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve a normal or supported unknown enum for its chassis, but must preserve the raw value and cannot use this case as substitute evidence for sensor accuracy or thermal stress.
expected_evidence: Approval, canonical mapping, expected Thermal State enum, enclosure mapping and tool/SMBIOS versions
Complete pre-reboot Type 3 record plus raw/decoded thermal-state comparison
Engineer verdict and separate live-thermal coverage reference if applicable

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The row sequence and Type 3 status grouping make Thermal State the single intended field; no competing thermal stimulus is specified.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The enum is identifiable and read-only; project expected value and mapping affect readiness only.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Rejects literal phrase filtering and adds complete record/enum evidence.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains the no-stimulus boundary but corrects its dual-field model and classification to FULLY AUTOMATABLE.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.v3_1_improvement: Separates static metadata from live temperature/sensor/stress coverage and records raw enum semantics.

review_improvement: Prevents empty output, invented dual-field acceptance and unapproved thermal manipulation while avoiding claims about untested dynamic behavior.
independent_technical_reasoning: This is a software-readable Type 3 enum persistence check. Once the approved baseline is supplied, the core flow is fully automatable.
